text:
lee_cs: Quick heads-up on Harborlight. Onboarding finished but they're seeing occasional 95p spikes (~2.3s) and token spend ~1.5x our forecast. Renewal in two months. Thinking a low-risk perf pilot: quantize + model hop + routing. Thoughts?

anu_se: +1. They care about latency first. Suggest small-model hop for short prompts and int8 for mid-length; keep fp16 for long contexts.

soren_ml: I ran a 75-sample eval. redwood-int8-stable keeps semantic parity ~0.986 median cosine. Failures mostly in long chained instructions. Recommend 2% canary + semantic gate.

tess_ops: infra note: Tenant on shared us-west. We can enable KV prefix caching which often trims tail time. Dedicated routing helps latency but increases monthly spend ~12%. Hybrid routing makes sense.

lee_cs: Plan draft: 1) 2% traffic to int8 for /summarize-short, 2) route tokens>900 to fp16, 3) enable KV cache for repeated templates, 4) semantic gate threshold 0.98. 48h pilot.

anu_se: routing snippet (example):
```
route: "harborlight-summarize"
policy:
  - condition: tokens(input) < 400 and rand() < 0.02
    target: redwood-small-1
  - condition: tokens(input) >= 400 and tokens(input) < 900 and rand() < 0.02
    target: redwood-int8-stable
  - condition: tokens(input) >= 900
    target: redwood-fp16-stable
fallback:
  - on_semantic_cosine_lt: 0.98
    action: route_to redwood-fp16-stable
  - on_latency_gt: 2200ms
    action: route_to redwood-dedicated-lowlatency
```

soren_ml: I'll produce a quick eval notebook and automation to compare outputs and compute cosine diffs.

nina_pm: Add a 1-question pulse after pilot: "Was summary speed acceptable? (yes / mostly / no)" Include ROI slide: est token savings 20-30% and 95p latency down ~25%.

tess_ops: ops checklist: provision canary nodes, toggle KV cache, add alerts: semantic_cosine < 0.98 for 20m and 95p_latency > 2200ms for 15m. I'll create a dashboard tile for cache hit rate.

ops-bot: alert created: channel=#cs-harborlight-alerts, semantic_cosine < 0.98 (20m), 95p_latency > 2200ms (15m). owner: tess_ops.

lee_cs: Timeline: start canary Wed 09:00 PT, monitor 48h, sync Thu EOD, ramp Fri if green. I'll message the customer and set the enablement 30m call Thu 11:00 PT. Thanks team :thumbsup:

anu_se: I'll draft the canary config and rollback playbook.

soren_ml: Sending notebook shortly. We'll gate ramp on semantic median >=0.98 and 95p < 1.7s.

lee_cs: Great — I'll post the customer note and attach ROI. Will update thread after kick-off.
